research.result: Complete catalogue, all three pages reviewed; selected exact producer-owned free feeds and checked CZ country permissions
All four official cinema feeds identified; Gorkogo/Lyubov/Muzhskoe passed; Klassika recovery pending
Additional cinema and nature candidates identified; advertised wmsAuthSign lease is 480 minutes. Not admitted without actual media proof and sustainable lease handling
Anonymous Espreso request using actual region CZ returned a guest HLS URL. Session update interval 300 seconds; not admitted without playback and session-lifetime confirmation

research.source: Red Media and licensed foreign cinema on Rutube
research.result: Rodnoe Kino, Kinomix, Kinokomediya plus sampled Movie Time, Filmach, Indian/Amazon feeds exclude CZ in country metadata. No region bypass attempted
Provider explicitly limits its app to subscribers within Ukraine; catalogue URL accessibility is not permission for free CZ viewing

RTG and Teleputeshestviya show distribution/programmes without a public linear source; Dikoe subscription page requires payment; Nasha Tema published source repeatedly unavailable; several old broadcaster domains are parked or unrelated and are not rights evidence

technical_findings.issue: Interleaved FFmpeg showinfo and ashowinfo stderr fabricated backward video PTS
technical_findings.evidence: Local saved EpicMediaLove.ru-timestamp-diagnostic.log: old parser read audio 8.021333 as video 7.88; new parser retains correct frame sequence
technical_findings.fix: Parse contiguous video/audio frame fields independently; unchanged durations, gap thresholds and strict decoding flags; timestamp_parser_version=2. Old failed observations retained, not promoted to success.
